title: Fundamental Rights: Equality (School)
description: An accessible explanation of equality rights and non-discrimination in Nepal's Constitution.

sections.title: What Equality Means
sections.content: Equality means treating people fairly under the law. It does not always mean treating everyone exactly the same, but making sure rules are not unfair or discriminatory.

sections.title: Protected Grounds
sections.content: The Constitution lists reasons people cannot be unfairly treated, such as origin, religion, gender, or disability. These are called protected grounds.

summary: Goal: dignity and opportunity for all.
